title: Eliminator Tech TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3 delivers authentic custom flair backed by modern impact mitigation, pairing relaxed road ergonomics with modern certified protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1415g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~94 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Flat-track inspired cruiser helmet with ProVision anti-fog shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive riding positions; offers a secure fit with minimal cheek pressure.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the Eliminator Tech TC-3 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3 represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~94 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Eliminator Tech TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
